name: integrable_prod_sub
statement: F₁ →L[𝕜] F₂ →L[𝕜] F₃) {f₁ : E → F₁} {f₂ : E → F₂} (hf₁ : Integrable f₁) (hf₂ : Integrable f₂) (hf₁' : Continuous f₁) (hf₂' : Continuous f₂) : Integrable (fun (p : E × E) ↦ ‖B‖ * (‖f₁ (p.1 - p.2)‖ * ‖f₂ p.2‖)) (volume.prod volume)

name: fourier_bilin_convolution_eq_integral
statement: F₁ →L[𝕜] F₂ →L[𝕜] F₃) {f₁ : E → F₁} {f₂ : E → F₂} (hf₁ : Integrable f₁) (hf₂ : Integrable f₂) (hf₁' : Continuous f₁) (hf₂' : Continuous f₂) (ξ : E) : 𝓕 (f₁ ⋆[B] f₂) ξ = ∫ y, ∫ x, 𝐞 (-inner ℝ (y + x) ξ) • B (f₁ x) (f₂ y)

name: fourier_bilin_convolution_eq
statement: F₁ →L[ℂ] F₂ →L[ℂ] F₃) {f₁ : E → F₁} {f₂ : E → F₂} (hf₁ : Integrable f₁) (hf₂ : Integrable f₂) (hf₁' : Continuous f₁) (hf₂' : Continuous f₂) (ξ : E) : 𝓕 (f₁ ⋆[B] f₂) ξ = B (𝓕 f₁ ξ) (𝓕 f₂ ξ)
